name: – After recital C – Am 9
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: Ca. whereas the recent floods in Romania have severely impacted more than 5 000 households and over 15 000 individuals, and have disrupted transportation by damaging four national roads; whereas, regrettably, the data indicate that at least seven individuals have lost their lives as a result of the floods;
